notes.title: Age of Invention Update OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's finally happening, Age of Invention Update is now available!

[h1]Trailer[/h1]
[previewyoutube=NHtQKWtfv0w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Devlog[/h1]
[previewyoutube=qmdqvk-trR0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 4 Craftable Inventions: Palletron, ClawBot, MagniGrab, Punch-O-Matic
[*] Added Mechnical Dungeon
[*] Added Finnegan the Tech Gnome
[*] Added 15 quests
[*] Added 34 Achievements
[*] Added TNT item line
[*] Added Mechanical Chest line, Gizmo Box, & Explosive Chest
[*] Added Mechanical Trinket
[*] Added Shrouded Oasis land
[*] Max Tool tier extended to T5.3
[*] Max Reforge tier extended to T25
[*] New Mini-Biome / Mining Feature
[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant performance improvements on Low Quality mode
[*] Several balance improvements with Mini Drills
[*] Furnaces now only ingests fuel when double clicking on them
[*] Furnaces & Mini Drills now has a loot bag limits based on their tier or level
[*] Improved visuals on Cave Chests to make them more distinguishable
[*] Improved visuals on the Cave Dungeon entrance
[*] Improved visuals on the Recruiter's Hub UI
[*] Improved visuals of the Runic Shop UI
[*] Improved sizes of certain Trinket trophies
[*] Updated Event icons
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get soft-locked during certain tutorials
[*] Fixed an issue where the Planter wouldn't show in certain scenarios
[*] Fixed an issue where a Trinket wouldn't evolve while repairing on an Anvil
[*] Fixed an issue where certain audio would not play correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where Quests with x1 reward wouldn't be showing on the UI
[*] Fixed an issue where the UI stalactites in the Cave Dungeon would freak out
[*] Fixed an issue where an empty Status Effect widget would show with no buff active
[*] Fixed an issue in the Trinket Store where the item name wouldn't be showing properly
[*] Fixed an issue where tools could be lost
[*] Fixed an issue with certain special font characters
[*] Fixed an issue where the Mini Drill could not drill into certain grid cells
[*] Fixed an issue where the Energy Bottle wasn't showing the correct material
[*] Fixed an error related to Dungeon grid cells
[*] Fixed an error related to Combo Merging
[/list]

Official Changelog Website:
https://fiveamp.com/mergecrafter/changelog/

notes.title: V1.14.3 - Recruiter Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We would like to thank each and every one of you for your amazing feedback and suggestions, you guys are awesome! We're striving to make MergeCrafter better with every update, so please, keep sharing your thoughts with us ❤️ 

With this update, we're launching a brand new [b]Recruiter System[/b] to reward players for inviting their friends & followers to join them in Runaria! Players receive a "[b]Scroll of Recruitment[/b]" that unlocks the Recruiter's Hub, this scroll can be used to credit another player for their recruitment. Players can view perks, copy recruiter code, track progress, and unlock a new trinket with unique sword skins as players invite new recruits. Whenever one of your recruits makes a Runic purchase - you will receive a 5% kickback in Runic yourself!
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Added[/h3]

[b]Recruiter System[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Scroll of Recruitment[/b] - [i]A scroll that can be consumed to attribute credit to another player who has recruited you. Discovering this scroll also grants access to the Recruiter's Hub[/i]
[*] [b]Glinting Sabre Trinket[/b] - [i]A powerful trinket that can be obtained by inviting friends to Runaria[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Home Camp terrain has been improved
[*] Copper Coins received a new color to differentiate them from Bronze
[*] Coin Dust received a new color to differentiate them from Bronze
[*] Improved quest rewards
[*] Russian Font has been reworked [i]- Special Thanks to SashaComics[/i]
[*] Several UI tweaks and improvements
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] A lot of bug fixes
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Recruiter's Hub[/b][/h1]
In the Recruiter's Hub, players can give credit, view perks, and track their progress.
It can be accessed by opening the Settings menu (≡)

[h3][b]Scroll of Recruitment[/b][/h3]
[b]New Players[/b]
- You will unlock this scroll early in the game as you're progressing through the lands of Runaria
[b]Existing Players[/b]
- This scroll can be claimed from your in-game mailbox

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565413/78e5a76ff154eec48d4bfe4ef6ff1e380d3d6e8c.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Inviting Players[/b][/h3]
Share your code with friends who have never played MergeCrafter before or new players that have not used their Scroll of Recruitment to increase your TIer to gain powerful and awesome Trinkets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565413/5ae564416fe89808d6d52352a7984b7cea5b3014.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565413/a1bbeee84a79304d51f8966d1d99f91c57c59467.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Recruitment Bonus[/b][/h3]
Whenever one of your Recruits make a Runic Store purchase, you will receive a 5% kickback in cold hard Runic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565413/2affe298dc8e93ad3aad7c966b807c669967324c.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Glinting Sabre Trinket[/h1]
[i]Powerful Trinkets. Those can be obtained by inviting players to Runaria![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42565413/76eeef2e3aa5b3abb650a00b646855ba8a0c0525.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Update[/h1]
We also have exciting news to share with you - our team is currently hard at work on a big update that will bring new systems and content to the game. We can't wait to unveil all the amazing features we have in store for you, so stay tuned for more information coming soon. Get ready to embark on new adventures and experience MergeCrafter!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Community[/h1]
Thank you for playing MergeCrafter!

We take our feedback and suggestions from our community very seriously and we, Fiveamp, want to make MergeCrafter the best game possible 😊

Please join our welcoming Discord Community server and share all of your feedback and suggestions!
